newsitem.title: POLAND: Austria's Ilbau Warsaw investment to top $42 mln.
newsitem.headline: Austria's Ilbau Warsaw investment to top $42 mln.

text.p: Austrian builder Ilbau said it wants to invest more than the earlier-agreed $42 million in the modernisation of four hotels of the Syrena chain it owns in Warsaw.
"We will invest more than $42 million in the modernisation of the Saski, Warszawa, Polonia and Nowa Praga hotels," Ilbau president Hans Haselsteiner told a news conference on Tuesday.
Earlier this year Ilbau paid $24 million for an 80 percent stake in the Syrena hotel chain in Warsaw with the municipality holding the remaining 20 percent.
Under the agreement Ilbau was to invest $42 million by 2004 or pay out an additional $14 million to the municipality if it failed to meet the deadline.
City authorities will give three quarters of its shares to Syrena employees for free and sell the rest to Ilbau.
